newsitem.title: CHILE: Salomon recommends hold Santander Chile.
newsitem.headline: Salomon recommends hold Santander Chile.

text.p: Salomon Brothers initiated coverage of Banco Santander Chile with a "hold" recommendation.

A report by Salomon analyst Jose Garcia-Cantera said Santander's acquisition of Banco Osorno will generate $35 million to $40 million in annual cost savings starting in 1997, more than originally expected when the merger occurred in April.
Salomon expected Banco Santander SA of Spain to issue around $250 million of shares of its Chilean subsidiary, which is likely to produce an equity "overhang" factor in the medium term.
"We recommend that investors participate in the offering at current prices," said the report.
